appearance_facts.fact: The blue solid line (labeled U.S. on the right axis) ends at a point in the upper-right quadrant, visually much higher than the red dashed line's endpoint at the same x.
The red dashed line (labeled Rest of the world on the left axis) ends at a point in the lower-right quadrant, near the bottom of the plot.
The red dashed line starts high in 2017, dips in 2018, rises in 2019, then falls sharply to 2020.
The blue solid line starts low in 2017, rises to a peak in 2019, then falls slightly to 2020.
The title 'Rest of the World vs U.S.' is displayed above the plot area.

printed_facts.fact: Left y-axis is labeled 'Rest of the world' in red text.
Right y-axis is labeled 'U.S.' in blue text.
Red square marker at 2018.0 has annotation '15875' below it.
Blue circle marker at 2018.0 has annotation '13993' above it.
Blue circle marker at 2019.0 has annotation '14272' above it.
Red square marker at 2019.0 has annotation '16194' below it.
No numerical annotations are printed for the 2020.0 data points for either series.
